beats.heading: 00 · Cold open. EXT. THE SWAMP, MORNING
beats.onScreen: Goose stands at the giant keyboard in front of the beige computer. The screen powers on as the line begins: a line of light opens into the app's window. On "This is Goose", hand-lettered words, This is Goose, with an arrow curving down to him.
beats.camera: SWAMP: medium, a little low, Goose and the computer both in frame, a slow push in.

lines.says: This is Goose. Today, Goose will make a music video.

beats.heading: 00 · Cold open. EXT. THE SWAMP, MORNING
beats.onScreen: Goose turns to the lens and strikes a star's pose, wings out, the lit app behind him.
beats.camera: SWAMP: medium, low.

lines.says: And learn the new raea app on the way, from start to finish.

beats.heading: 01 · Find your way. THE APP
beats.onScreen: A computer's desktop (a Mac's, in the take), the swamp as its wallpaper, the Dock along the bottom. The pointer goes to raea's icon in the Dock and clicks; the icon bounces and the app's window opens out of it.
beats.camera: DESKTOP: the whole screen, still.

lines.says: raea is an app on your computer. Open it like any other app.

beats.heading: 01 · Find your way. THE APP
beats.onScreen: The app, whole. An outline rises round the rail on the left as it's named; the pointer runs down the projects in it.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the rail.

lines.says: The app has three parts. Down the left, the rail: your projects.
To widen it, click the button at its foot. Click again to fold it.

beats.heading: 01 · Find your way. THE APP
beats.onScreen: The pointer clicks a project in the rail.
beats.camera: CLOSE on the project's tile as it's clicked, the click's ring; then straight back out to the whole app.

lines.says: Open one.

beats.heading: 01 · Find your way. THE APP
beats.onScreen: The project open: an outline round the chat in the middle, then round its box at the bottom.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the chat, then its box.

lines.says: In the middle is its chat, where you ask its agent, the AI doing the work, for what you want.

beats.heading: 01 · Find your way. THE APP
beats.onScreen: An outline round the panel on the right, its feed; the pointer goes to it.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the panel.

lines.says: On the right, its feed. Everything the agent makes lands there.

beats.heading: 02 · Connect your AI. CONNECTIONS
beats.onScreen: Goose from behind, by the water. Over his head, a ring of the AIs' logos hangs in the air. Each lights as it's named, and Goose turns his head to it: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Kimi.
beats.camera: SWAMP: behind Goose and a little above, headroom for the ring; a slow drift round him.

lines.says: First, raea needs an AI to do the work: the one you already pay for, like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Kimi.

beats.heading: 02 · Connect your AI. CONNECTIONS
beats.onScreen: The app. The pointer goes down to the rail's foot; an outline on Connections as it's named; a click, and Connections opens.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Connections.

lines.says: You connect it in Connections, at the foot of the rail.

beats.heading: 02 · Connect your AI. CONNECTIONS
beats.onScreen: Connections, its Agents rows. The pointer clicks Connect on Claude; its sign-in opens beside it.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the Agents rows; CLOSE on the Claude row for the click; back out.

lines.says: Under Agents, click Connect on yours, and sign in with your own account.

beats.heading: 03 · Ask for it. THE CHAT
beats.onScreen: The + in the rail, outlined; New project; "Swamp Goose" typed; Make clicked. The project opens.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the +, then on the form as the name goes in and Make is clicked.

lines.says: Goose's video needs a project. The plus in the rail makes one: give it a name, and click Make.

beats.heading: 03 · Ask for it. THE CHAT
beats.onScreen: Under the box, Pick an AI: Kimi picked. Then Goose stomps out the line on the giant keyboard, key by key; the box fills: "make me a music video. me, in a swamp, summoning ancient magic". Send.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the AI picker; SWAMP over the keys with Goose, wide; APP as the box fills.

lines.says: Under the box, pick the AI to run it. Then say what you want, the way you'd tell a person, and send.

beats.heading: 03 · Ask for it. THE CHAT
beats.onScreen: The agent's answer arriving; "1 running" folded over the box, outlined; then Stop beside Send, outlined.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on "1 running", then on Stop.

lines.says: While it works, what it's running shows over the box. If it wanders, Stop is right beside it.

beats.heading: 03 · Ask for it. THE CHAT
beats.onScreen: Slash goal typed in the box. Then Goose types "honk" after it. Nothing happens for a beat.
beats.camera: APP, the box outlined; held still on "/goal honk" for the beat.
cues: after "not a condition": Goose honks back, once, offended, off screen; the app stays up

lines.says: To keep it going until the job's really done, type slash goal and a condition. It works until that's true.
"Honk" is not a condition.
lines.how: after a held beat on /goal honk

beats.heading: 03 · Ask for it. THE CHAT
beats.onScreen: The goal deleted, and "/goal every shot has me in it" typed in its place. The goal settles over the box.
beats.camera: APP throughout: the box outlined as the goal is typed and settles.

lines.says: A good goal is something the agent can check in the work itself. Not "make it good", but "every shot has me in it".

beats.heading: 04 · Watch it work. THE FEED
beats.onScreen: In real time: the agent's plan appears, then its steps one after another in the chat (Building the swamp…). In the feed, the stills land one by one, then the first cut.
beats.camera: APP, whole, so the chat and the feed are both seen filling; OUTLINE on the feed as the cut lands.
cues: a soft drip for each card

lines.says: Then it gets to work, and you can watch: each step shows in the chat as it happens, and each thing it makes lands in the feed. First the stills, then the cut.

beats.heading: 04 · Watch it work. THE FEED
beats.onScreen: The cut's card changes to v2, "the summoning longer"; the goal's check in the chat: "GOAL MET: Goose is in every shot of version 2."
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the card's v2, then on the goal's line in the chat.

lines.says: It made a second version on its own, with a longer summoning. Then the goal checked it, shot by shot: Goose is in every one.

beats.heading: 04 · Watch it work. THE FEED
beats.onScreen: The pointer clicks the cut's card; it grows to full size.
beats.camera: APP, whole.

lines.says: Click anything in the feed to open it.

beats.heading: 04 · Watch it work. THE FEED
beats.onScreen: Goose in the swamp turns to the lens.
beats.camera: SWAMP: medium, Goose square to the lens.

lines.says: With me so far?

beats.heading: 04 · Watch it work. THE FEED
beats.onScreen: Goose settles by the water. Beside him, a card: raea's community on Discord, discord.gg/ZCfeKDPgXX.
beats.camera: SWAMP: wide and calm; GRAPHIC: the Discord card.

lines.says: It's fine if this is a lot at first. Everyone's new to it once. If you get stuck, ask in raea's community on Discord. The link's on screen.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: The cut open at version 2, playing to 0:58: Goose spread-winged over the keyboard, his wings flat planks; an outline round the wings. In the swamp Goose flaps his own: planks, and they clack.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the wings; SWAMP, Goose medium, the planks across the frame.

lines.says: Back to the cut. It's a music video about Goose, so he watched himself first. His wings looked like planks.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: The pointer clicks Comment, then the wing in the picture; a pin; the box: "my wings look like planks".
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Comment; CLOSE on the wing as the pin lands; back out as the note's typed.

lines.says: He chose Comment, clicked on the wing, and said so.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: Under the note, Edit | Note. The pointer clicks Note as it's named, then Edit as it's named, then rests on Edit.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Edit | Note; CLOSE enough to read them, held while the pointer moves between them.

lines.says: A note can do one of two things. Note keeps it for you, as a reminder.
Edit asks the agent to make the change. Goose wants a change, so: Edit.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: Send. The panel goes to Tasks: the agent's tasks, each linked to the note.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Send, then on Tasks.

lines.says: Send, and your notes become the agent's plan in Tasks, each task pointing back at its note.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: In real time: the agent at work in the chat, its task ticked off, and the cut's card in the feed turning to v3; the wings drawn as wings.
beats.camera: APP, whole; OUTLINE on the card as it turns to v3.

lines.says: When it's done, the fix comes back as the next version, on the same card.

beats.heading: 05 · Ask for a change. NOTES AND VERSIONS
beats.onScreen: The version menu beside the title, outlined; it opens: v3, v2, v1. The pointer picks v2: the planks again. Then v3: feathers. In the swamp, Goose's planks turn to feathers and he flaps, lifting off the mud for a moment.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the version menu; SWAMP, Goose low against the sky for the flap.

lines.says: Every version is kept. To go back to one, pick it from the version menu, next to the title.

beats.heading: 06 · Finish it. EXPORT
beats.onScreen: The film's header, Export outlined; the pointer clicks it: "Exported to Swamp Goose.mp4".
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Export, then on the line it leaves.

lines.says: When it's right, Export, top right, saves the film to your computer.

beats.heading: 06 · Finish it. EXPORT
beats.onScreen: The ⋯ at the timeline's right end opens its menu: Show in Finder, outlined; clicked.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the ⋯, then on Show in Finder.

lines.says: Show in Finder, under the dots at the end of the timeline, takes you to the file. From there it goes into CapCut, or any editor you like.

beats.heading: 07 · Set it once. CONTROLLERS
beats.onScreen: The Controllers tab: one controller, Delivery. Outlines on Shape (18:9), Loudness (-14) and Captions as each is named.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on each field as it's named.

lines.says: Some choices hold for every film Goose makes: the shape, eighteen by nine; the loudness, minus fourteen; captions on.
Instead of saying them in every chat, they live in a controller: a panel of settings every agent reads before it starts. Goose's agent made this one when it began.

beats.heading: 07 · Set it once. CONTROLLERS
beats.onScreen: Goose pecks the Loudness knob and holds on, twisting his whole neck: the knob turns with it, up to -6, its top. In the swamp, the frogs get louder.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the knob; one cut to the swamp.

lines.says: Change one, and whatever an agent makes next follows it.

beats.heading: 07 · Set it once. CONTROLLERS
beats.onScreen: The knob goes slowly back to -14; the frogs settle.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the knob.

lines.says: Goose left loudness at minus fourteen.

beats.heading: 07 · Set it once. CONTROLLERS
beats.onScreen: The + in the tab's bar; New controller opens: "Describe what it should decide, in a sentence." A sentence typed; Create; the new controller builds itself in.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on the +, then on the form's sentence; whole as it builds.

lines.says: To make your own, click the plus and describe in a sentence what it should decide. raea builds it as settings you can set.

beats.heading: 08 · Find your way round a project. THE PANEL'S TABS
beats.onScreen: The panel's tabs, outlined; the pointer clicks each as it's named, and the panel changes with it: Feed's cards; Source, the project's files; Tasks, the plan; Controllers, Delivery.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on each tab and the panel under it.

lines.says: The panel has four tabs. Feed is the work. Source is everything it's made of. Tasks is the agent's plan. Controllers, its settings.

beats.heading: 09 · Share it. REVIEW LINKS AND PUBLISH
beats.onScreen: Share, beside Export, outlined: its panel opens on Review link. Then the link goes out to the swamp's reviewers: the frog on its stone, the heron in the shallows and the deer by the drum each turn to the giant glass.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Share and the panel's Review link; then SWAMP, the three reviewers, one quick shot each.

lines.says: For other people's notes, Share makes a review link. On Pro, anyone can watch, comment on the frame and approve, with no account.

beats.heading: 09 · Share it. REVIEW LINKS AND PUBLISH
beats.onScreen: The rail's foot: Publish outlined, clicked; Publish opens on its tabs, Needs you first.
beats.camera: APP, OUTLINE on Publish in the rail, then on its tabs.

lines.says: Their reviews come back in Publish, at the foot of the rail, with what needs you on top.

beats.heading: 09 · Share it. REVIEW LINKS AND PUBLISH
beats.onScreen: The heron cranes its neck right out at the glass, a "!" over its head (a note); the deer nods, a heart over its head (an approval); the frog looks at the glass a moment longer, and hops off its stone into the water.
beats.camera: SWAMP: the heron, then the deer, each with the glass behind it; then close on the frog.
cues: a heron's croak on its note

lines.says: The heron had notes. The deer approved.
Reviews were mixed.

beats.heading: 10 · Teach it your eye. FINGERPRINT
beats.onScreen: GRAPHIC over the swamp: this film's notes drift in, each in its own words ("my wings look like planks", the heron's "!", the deer's heart), and gather into a fingerprint's whorls.
beats.camera: GRAPHIC, over a soft swamp.

lines.says: Every note you leave teaches raea what you look for: what you flag, and what you approve. Together, that's your fingerprint.

beats.heading: 10 · Teach it your eye. FINGERPRINT
beats.onScreen: GRAPHIC: a new cut's strip; the fingerprint passes along it and marks two moments, each labelled in the note's own words ("wings look like planks"); they're fixed, and the strip goes to the feed clean.
beats.camera: GRAPHIC.

lines.says: Before an agent shows you a cut, it checks it against your fingerprint, and fixes what you'd have flagged. So the same note doesn't come up twice.

beats.heading: 10 · Teach it your eye. FINGERPRINT
beats.onScreen: GRAPHIC over the swamp: Goose's words in a chat bubble, "make it a rule: I'm in every shot"; it folds into a card, Rules, a line under Always: "Goose is in every shot." Then two notes the same ("can't see me here", twice), and over them "A standing rule?"; the card gains it. Fingerprint, Rules lettered under it.
beats.camera: GRAPHIC, over a soft swamp.

lines.says: When a note should hold for the whole project, tell your agent: make it a rule. Every agent works to it from then on.
Make the same fix twice, and raea asks if it's a standing rule. You'll find them all in Fingerprint, under Rules.

beats.heading: 10 · Teach it your eye. FINGERPRINT
beats.onScreen: GRAPHIC: a computer, drawn, with the fingerprint's whorls turning on its screen; "8 GB memory" and "2 GB free" pinned beside it. Then frames of Goose's finished video fly into the screen and the whorls fill out.
beats.camera: GRAPHIC.

lines.says: It all runs on your own computer. Eight gigabytes of memory and two free on disk are enough.
To give it a head start, ask your agent to learn from your finished renders.

beats.heading: 11 · The workflow. THE FINISHED VIDEO
beats.onScreen: The finished music video plays on the giant monitor, the first time we see it whole; Goose watches it, bobbing.
beats.camera: SWAMP: low behind Goose, the glass beyond, drifting round him.
cues: the song comes up as the voice ends

lines.says: That's the workflow. Ask in the chat. Watch it land in the feed. Point at what's wrong, and get the next version. Then ship it.

beats.heading: 11 · The workflow. THE FINISHED VIDEO
beats.onScreen: On black: raea's mark, raea.io/docs, and the Discord link.
